# Maths plane — Style Prompt

> A pure black stage with a faint number plane, and a quiet teacher's voice made visible. Every line is written onto the screen stroke by stroke, outlines first and then the fill flooding in; a thin yellow box draws itself round the one thing to look at, the term turns yellow, and the box lets go. Colours mean something: blue is what goes in, green is what comes out, yellow is the focus. The camera never moves; scenes change by dipping to black; numbers count smoothly with their decimals; the rhythm is fast, fast, slow.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The look of a maths animation that explains an idea by intuition. **One locked frame** on a black number plane; text arrives by being **written**; attention is directed by **circling** the term, never by making it bigger or louder; and **colour is a legend**: a word is blue because it is an input, green because it is a result, yellow because it is the focus right now. A beat writes its lines quickly, adds its marks, and then holds still long enough to think: fast, fast, slow. When one thing becomes another, it **transforms** on screen (matching symbols glide to their new places) instead of fading out and in.

Not a kinetic-type promo (no slams, no bounce, no overshoot, no shake), not a slideshow (no hard cuts or flashes between scenes), not a whiteboard (no hand, no marker texture, no paper), not a neon HUD (no glow, no shadows, no scanlines, no gradients on text), and not decorative colour: a colour that means nothing does not appear.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Stage**: flat `--latar`, pure black in the look's own colours. Nothing else is filled.
- **Number plane**: one CSS gradient layer, drawn once and never moved: a 135 px grid of 1.5 px lines in the input colour at 13-16% (offset −15 px vertically), plus two axes, 2 px in `--teks` at 32%: the x-axis at y 1335 and the y-axis at x 540. The axes cross the reading area on purpose; the text sits over them.
- **Glyphs, not cards**: the frame holds text and a few thin marks only: the chapter rule (220 × 2 px), the circumscribe rectangle (3 px stroke, 6 px corner radius, no fill), bullet dots, and the swatches in the stamp.
- **Write**: while a glyph is unfilled it shows its outline (2.2 px stroke in its own colour); the fill then floods in to solid. No other texture, grain, glow or shadow anywhere.
- **Corner stamp** (the series mark), left 80 px, below the x-axis: a mono label (24 px, 0.2em tracking, muted), the name in the serif at 54 px with a 32 px muted aside, and a row of five 34 px swatches, 10 px apart: background (outlined), text, focus, input, output. It is the colour legend of the whole video and stays for the whole film.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the black stage and the dip curtain. `--teks`: everything simply said (titles, list items, the hero figure, notes). `--teks-redup`: the stamp's label and aside.
- `--utama` plays **focus** (the look's yellow, #f7d96f): the circumscribe box and the focused term, both through `--utama-di-latar`; its swatch. Focus is one thing at a time.
- `--aksen` plays **input** (the look's blue, #58c4dd): the chapter number, labels, bullets, the chapter rule and the grid tint, all through `--aksen-di-latar`.
- **Output** is the look's own token `--hasil`: a fixed green (#58ab30) mixed 76% with `--teks`, which is the reference green (#82c069) on black, and a deeper green (4.5:1 on white) on a pale brand. Units, results, the right-hand side of "=".
- No filled panels: `--latar-2`, `--teks-di-utama` and `--teks-di-aksen` are only for a rare filled tag (a yellow tag carries `--teks-di-utama`).
- On a pale brand the focus and input words fall back to the text colour when the brand's colours would not read: the box still marks the focus, so the meaning moves from hue to shape. Never recolour a word for decoration, and never use a meaning colour for a different meaning in the same video.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` is the maths serif: **Libre Baskerville 400** (lining figures, the closest bundled face). Chapter number 180 px (−0.04em), chapter title 124 px, list title 88 px, hero figure 290 px (−0.05em, line height 0.9) with its unit as a superscript at 0.42em, the result line under it 88 px.
- `--font-isi`: list items and body, Libre Baskerville 400 at 64 px, line height 1.1.
- Look tokens: `--font-label` **IBM Plex Mono 600**, caps, 30 px, 0.06em tracking for the small labels above titles; `--font-mat` **Playfair Display italic** at 56 px for notes, conditions and variables (the maths italic).
- Everything is centred. Titles break between words and balance their lines. Decimals in Indonesian style ("50,7").
- When the brand has no fonts: Libre Baskerville for everything serif; Cormorant Garamond 500 for a lighter bookish voice in text (its old-style figures do not suit hero numbers); never a sans for the numbers of this look. A wider brand font wraps titles to two balanced lines; keep a hero figure to four digits plus its unit.

## 5. Motion quality

- **One curve**: a smooth symmetric in-out, cubic (0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), which is the timeline `power2.inOut`, for enters, exits and marks. No overshoot, no elastic, no back.
- **Write**: per character, the outline is uncovered left to right (`clip-path` inset, 0.55 s, linear) and the fill floods in from 0.4 s (0.7 s, `power1.inOut`); characters 0.05 s apart, capped so a whole line's stagger stays within 0.4 s. A line takes 1.1-1.5 s; a second line starts 0.15 s after the first. Small text (labels, notes) runs at 0.8-0.85×.
- **Circumscribe**: the box strokes round the term in 0.55 s; from +0.1 s the term turns focus colour (0.3 s) and pulses to 1.08 and back (0.25 s each way, sine); at +1.15 s the box fades over 0.4 s while the colour stays. On a final answer the box stays.
- **Grow from the bullet**: list rows enter from scale 0.6 anchored at the list's left edge and opacity 0, to full over 1.0 s, rows 0.5 s apart.
- **Decimal counter**: the figure fades in over 0.25 s while it counts from zero for 1.3 s (`power2.inOut`), always showing its decimals, landing exactly on the value.
- **Rule**: grows from its centre in 0.5 s.
- **Dip**: a `--latar` curtain over everything (plane and stamp too) rises in 0.5 s (`power1.in`), the scene is swapped under it, and it lifts in 0.6 s (`power1.out`).
- **Rhythm** (the reference): chapter 2.4 s, then a list scene of about 6 s (written by 4.4 s, focus at 4.75 s, rows to 7.6 s, held 1.7 s), then the answer of about 5 s that ends still for at least 2 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked: there is no push, pan or drift. What moves is the writing and the marks.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame on the plane | careful, exact, nothing to hide | every beat |
| Dip to black (0.5 s down, 0.6 s up) | a new step of the argument | between scenes |
| Write, outline then fill | the thought is being formed now | titles, statements, units, contacts |
| Circumscribe and let go | "look at this one" | the key number or term in a sentence |
| Boxed and kept | "this is the answer" | the final result, the price, the contact |
| Transform (morph) | this becomes that | before/after, simplifying, comparing two options |
| Grow from the bullet | one more reason | lists, steps, ingredients of an idea |

## 7. Native moves

- **The written chapter card.** A blue index number and the title are written stroke by stroke in the middle of the plane, a thin rule grows from the centre under them, a mono label is written last. *Fits content like:* "Paradoks 23" opening a probability lesson; "Cara kerja filter air" for a shop that sells water filters; a science creator's "Episode 4: Kenapa langit biru?"; a mystery story's "Bab 2: Peta yang hilang".
- **Circumscribe and let go.** A yellow box draws round one term, the term turns yellow and pulses once, the box disappears and the colour stays as a reminder. *Fits content like:* "Ada 253 pasangan"; "cuma 3 bahan" on a recipe channel; "hemat 40%" for a solar panel installer; the one suspicious word in a witness's sentence.
- **The decimal tracker.** A large serif figure counts smoothly from zero with its decimals, then its meaning is written under it in green. *Fits content like:* 50,7% chance two classmates share a birthday; 4,8 km saved by a delivery route; 12,5 hours of practice a week for a music course; 99,2% of a story's letters delivered.
- **Grow from the bullet.** Each point grows from the left of the list with its blue dot, half a second apart, while the title stays. *Fits content like:* three reasons for an answer; the three steps of a repair service; a creator's three editing rules; the three clues found in a room.
- **Meaning colours.** Inputs in blue, results in green, the focus in yellow, everything else white; the stamp's swatches keep the legend on screen. *Fits content like:* "23 × 22 ÷ 2 = 253" with the result green; a price breakdown where the total is green; a recipe where ingredients are blue and the dish is green; a story's clue (blue) leading to its answer (green).
- **Transform, not fade.** When an expression changes, split both into characters, pair identical characters left to right, glide each pair from its old place to its new one (0.8 s, `power2.inOut`), fade the unpaired old ones (0.3 s) and write the new ones. *Fits content like:* "Rp150.000 − 20%" becoming "Rp120.000"; "x + x" becoming "2x" in a lesson; a creator's old title becoming the new one; "kemarin" becoming "hari ini" in a story.
- **The boxed answer.** The last result gets a box that stays, and the frame holds for two seconds or more. *Fits content like:* the condition under a final percentage; the price of a class; the chat number of a tutoring service; the last line of a riddle.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Performance.** Write animates `clip-path` and one custom property per character: keep at most about 40 characters writing at once, and clear the clip (`none`) when a line is done. Hide waiting scenes with `autoAlpha`. The plane is a single gradient layer, never hundreds of divs; never animate it.
- **Initial states** come from the timeline (`fromTo` on the clip, the fill and the curtain), not from CSS that hides text.
- **Meaning.** A colour without a meaning, or two focus boxes at once, breaks the look. Yellow is never a glow; the box is a flat 3 px stroke.
- **Boxes in a sentence.** The box sits outside the glyphs (0.16em on each side): give the boxed term 0.1em of margin so the box does not touch its neighbours.
- **Counters.** Centre the whole figure with its unit so changing digit widths do not shift the composition off centre; frame-exact values; the last frame shows the exact value. Compute every figure, never round it into a different claim, and write its condition on screen (the italic note).
- **Endings.** The final mark must be finished at least 2 s before the end and then stay; do not fade the last box.
- **Light brands.** Check that the box still shows when the focus falls back to the text colour, that the grid stays faint, and that the green stays readable.
- **Safe zones.** Reading text stays within y 400-1300 and 80 px from the sides; the stamp sits under the x-axis with its bottom 386 px above the frame edge.

## Measured from the references

- Timing in the reference: chapter fully on 0-2.3 s; dip 2.3-3.4 s (covered at 2.8 s); the list label and title are written from 3.1 s and filled by 4.0 s; circumscribe at 4.75 s (box gone by 6.3 s); rows grow at 5.6, 6.1 and 6.6 s; hold to 9.45 s; dip to 10.6 s; the counter runs from 10.35 s for 1.3 s; the result line is written from 11.75 s and the note from 12.1 s; the last circumscribe starts at 13.35 s.
- Layout at 1080 × 1920: chapter number centred at y 775, title at y 954, rule at y 1041, label at y 1089; list label at y 429, title at y 517, rows at y 874, 1002 and 1129 (128 px apart); hero figure centred at y 775, result line at y 986, note at y 1113; the stamp's label at y 1450 in the reference (raised here to about y 1400 for the bottom safe zone).

# Maths plane: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 4.2, long 6.2.

## hook

- en: a centred chapter card: a blue index number and the title written stroke by stroke, a thin rule grows from the middle
- id: kartu bab di tengah: nomor biru dan judul ditulis per goresan, garis tipis tumbuh dari tengah

## problem

- en: the wrong claim is written in white, a yellow box circles the culprit word, then it is struck through with one ruled line
- id: anggapan yang keliru ditulis putih, kotak kuning melingkari kata biangnya, lalu dicoret satu garis

## fact

- en: one line written stroke by stroke under a small blue label, the key term boxed in yellow and left yellow
- id: satu kalimat ditulis per goresan di bawah label biru kecil, istilah kuncinya dikotak kuning dan tetap kuning

## step

- en: the title is written, its number boxed; points grow from their blue bullets one by one, 0.5 s apart
- id: judul ditulis, angkanya dikotak; poin tumbuh dari titik birunya satu per satu, jeda 0,5 detik

## compare

- en: one expression morphs into the other: matching symbols glide to their new places, the rest fade, blue in and green out
- id: satu rumus berubah bentuk jadi rumus lain: simbol yang sama meluncur ke tempat barunya, input biru, hasil hijau

## number

- en: one large serif figure counts smoothly from zero with its decimals; its unit is written in green underneath
- id: satu angka serif besar dihitung halus dari nol lengkap dengan desimalnya; satuannya ditulis hijau di bawah

## proof

- en: the working is written line by line, each line aligned on its = sign; the result is boxed in yellow
- id: langkah hitungan ditulis baris demi baris, rata di tanda =; hasilnya dikotak kuning

## offer

- en: the offer written as a short equation (inputs in blue, the result in green), the price boxed in yellow
- id: penawaran ditulis seperti persamaan pendek (input biru, hasil hijau), harganya dikotak kuning

## cta

- en: the name written in serif, the contact in mono under it, one yellow box drawn round the contact and kept; held 2 s
- id: nama ditulis serif, kontak di bawahnya huruf mono, satu kotak kuning digambar di kontak dan tetap; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the answer counts up large, its meaning is written in green, the condition below gets a box that stays; held 2 s
- id: jawaban dihitung besar, artinya ditulis hijau, syarat di bawahnya dikotak dan kotaknya tetap; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Animasi matematika</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Libre Baskerville"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Playfair Display"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama.
         Warna bermakna: --utama = fokus (kuning), --aksen = masukan (biru), --hasil = keluaran (hijau). */
      :root {
        --latar: #000000; --latar-2: #101214; --utama: #f7d96f; --aksen: #58c4dd;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #8a8a8a; --teks-di-utama: #000000; --teks-di-aksen: #000000;
        --utama-di-latar: #f7d96f; --aksen-di-latar: #58c4dd;
        --font-judul: "Libre Baskerville", "Noto Serif", serif; --font-isi: "Libre Baskerville", "Noto Serif", serif;
        /* Milik tampilan ini. Hijau hasil tetap, tapi ikut terang brand: di latar gelap #83c167, di latar terang lebih tua. */
        --hasil: color-mix(in oklab, #58ab30 76%, var(--teks));
        --font-label: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;
        --font-mat: "Playfair Display", serif;
        --kisi: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen-di-latar) 13%, transparent);
        --sumbu: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 32%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar);
        color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      .lap { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      /* Bidang koordinat: kisi 135 px biru samar, sumbu x di y 1335 dan sumbu y di x 540. Kamera terkunci: tidak bergerak. */
      #bidang { background: linear-gradient(var(--kisi) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px) 0 -15px / 135px 135px,
        linear-gradient(90deg, var(--kisi) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px) 0 -15px / 135px 135px; }
      #bidang::before, #bidang::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: var(--sumbu); }
      #bidang::before { left: 0; right: 0; top: 1335px; height: 2px; }
      #bidang::after { top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 539px; width: 2px; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .wd { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; }
      /* Write: garis tepi huruf dulu, lalu isinya membanjir (--wf 0 → 1). */
      .tulis .ch { -webkit-text-fill-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor calc(var(--wf, 1) * 100%), transparent);
        -webkit-text-stroke: calc((1 - var(--wf, 1)) * 2.2px) currentColor; }
      .lbl { font-family: var(--font-label); font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .jdl { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.04; word-break: keep-all; text-wrap: balance; }
      /* Kata fokus: --g 0 → 1 menggeser warnanya dari teks ke kuning fokus. Kotaknya digambar di atas kata. */
      em { font-style: normal; position: relative; display: inline-block; margin: 0 0.1em; --g: 0;
        color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) calc(var(--g) * 100%), var(--teks)); }
      .kotak { position: absolute; left: -0.16em; top: -0.02em; width: calc(100% + 0.32em); height: calc(100% + 0.04em); overflow: visible; }
      .kotak rect { fill: none; stroke: var(--utama-di-latar); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 100; }

      /* Adegan 1: kartu bab di tengah. */
      #kartu { position: absolute; left: 70px; right: 70px; top: 700px; text-align: center; }
      #kartu .num { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 180px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      #kartu .ttl { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 124px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
      #kartu .rule { margin: 30px auto 0; width: 220px; height: 2px; background: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      #kartu .lbl { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Adegan 2: label dan judul di atas, daftar berpoin di tengah. */
      #kepala { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; text-align: center; }
      #kepala .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 88px; }
      #daftar { position: absolute; left: 160px; right: 160px; top: 820px; list-style: none; }
      #daftar li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; padding: 26px 0; }
      #daftar .idx { font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 54px; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      #daftar .txt { font-size: 64px; line-height: 1.1; }
      .out { color: var(--hasil); }
      /* Adegan 3: satu angka besar, satuan hijau (hasil), catatan italik dengan angka yang dikotak. */
      #jawab { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 640px; text-align: center; }
      #nilai { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 290px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }
      #nilai::after { content: "%"; display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 0.06em;
        vertical-align: top; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.1em; }
      #satuan { margin-top: 18px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 88px; color: var(--hasil); }
      #catatan { margin-top: 40px; font-family: var(--font-mat); font-style: italic; font-size: 56px; }
      /* Penanda tetap kiri bawah: label, nama kelas, lima titik warna bermakna. */
      #tanda { position: absolute; left: 80px; bottom: 386px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      #tanda .lbl { font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tanda .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 54px; line-height: 1.1; }
      #tanda .n small { margin-left: 16px; font-size: 32px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #titik { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      #titik i { display: block; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--kisi); }
      /* Dip: seluruh layar meredup ke warna latar saat pindah adegan. */
      #dip { background: var(--latar); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="lap" id="bidang"></div>

      <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: nomor bab biru dan judul ditulis per goresan, garis tumbuh dari tengah, label. -->
        <div id="kartu">
          <div class="num">01</div>
          <div class="ttl jdl">Paradoks 23</div>
          <div class="rule"></div>
          <div class="lbl">Teka-teki peluang · kelas 9</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step"><!-- Adegan 2, langkah: judul ditulis, angka fokus dikotak kuning lalu dilepas, poin tumbuh dari kiri satu per satu. -->
        <div id="kepala">
          <div class="lbl">Kenapa bisa?</div>
          <div class="ttl jdl">Ada <em id="fokus">253</em> pasangan</div>
        </div>
        <ul id="daftar">
          <li><span class="idx">•</span><span class="txt">23 murid sekelas</span></li>
          <li><span class="idx">•</span><span class="txt">tiap dua = 1 pasang</span></li>
          <li><span class="idx">•</span><span class="txt">23 × 22 ÷ 2 = <span class="out">253</span></span></li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s3" data-role="payoff"><!-- Adegan 3, jawaban: angka dihitung halus, satuan hijau ditulis, angka di catatan dikotak dan kotaknya tetap. -->
        <div id="jawab">
          <div id="nilai">50,7</div>
          <div id="satuan">ada yang kembar</div>
          <div id="catatan">dari <em id="kunci">23 murid</em> · 365 hari</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div id="tanda">
        <div class="lbl">Kelas 03 / 12</div>
        <div class="n">Nalar Peluang<small>kelas daring</small></div>
        <div id="titik"><i style="background: var(--latar)"></i><i style="background: var(--teks)"></i><i style="background: var(--utama)"></i><i style="background: var(--aksen)"></i><i style="background: var(--hasil)"></i></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lap" id="dip"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      (() => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
        const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s), $$ = (s) => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
        const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
        const HALUS = "power2.inOut"; // ≈ cubic(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1): kurva "smooth" matematika, untuk masuk, keluar, dan gerak

        // Pecah teks jadi huruf (.ch); huruf satu kata dalam .wd supaya baris tidak patah di tengah kata.
        function huruf(el) {
          const out = [];
          const walk = (node) => [...node.childNodes].forEach((n) => {
            if (n.nodeType === 1) return walk(n);
            if (n.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (const tok of n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/)) {
              if (!tok) continue;
              if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { frag.append(" "); continue; }
              const w = frag.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "wd" }));
              for (const c of tok) out.push(w.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "ch", textContent: c })));
            }
            n.replaceWith(frag);
          });
          walk(el);
          return out;
        }
        // Write: tiap huruf dibuka kiri→kanan sebagai garis tepi (0,55 dtk), isi membanjir 0,4 dtk kemudian (0,7 dtk);
        // jeda antarhuruf 0,05 dtk, dibatasi supaya satu baris selesai ≤ 0,4 dtk. d memperpendek semuanya.
        function tulis(el, t, d = 1) {
          const cs = huruf(el), stg = Math.min(0.05, (0.4 * d) / Math.max(1, cs.length - 1));
          el.classList.add("tulis");
          tl.fromTo(cs, { clipPath: "inset(-30% 100% -30% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(-30% 0% -30% 0%)", duration: 0.55 * d, stagger: stg, ease: "none" }, t);
